title: A.live Composable, Remixable NFT Protocol
tagline: The a.live remix tool allows you to permissionlessly mashup any piece of music and mint user generated content as a new NFT.
description:
In a Web2 world, users and original creators do not get fairly compensated for their user generated content. On Tiktok, for example, you can have a reel go viral with a billion views, but neither the creator nor any music (or other creative output) used in the creation of the reel gets fairly compensated by the platform itself. 
In a Web3 world, licensing, attribution, and fair use can be updated and enforced on-chain permissionlessly.
One of the use cases we’ve imagined for the NFTs artists release on our platform (and others, using our protocol) is the ability of fans to create user generated content (think fan remixes, mashups of multiple songs, etc.) permissionlessly.
